LIAR'S DECK — THE LAST CALL

TIENG VIET
1. Giai nen thu muc nay (neu dang o trong ZIP).
2. Nhap dup PLAY.cmd hoac Liars-Deck.html, mo bang Chrome/Edge/Firefox.
3. Chon 2-4 nguoi, nhap ten, chon nhan vat va bam START GAME.
4. Choi bai that. Nguoi thua chon nhan vat cua minh va bam FIRE.
5. Manage players: sua ten, reset tung nguoi. New match: bat dau lai.
Khong can Internet, Node hay cai dat thu vien.
Giu nguyen vi tri file va dung cung trinh duyet de tiep tuc van da luu.
Khong xoa du lieu trinh duyet neu muon giu van choi.

ENGLISH
Open Liars-Deck.html directly in a modern browser. No installation or Internet required.
Choose 2-4 players, names and skins, then start. Play cards physically; select the
loser of a challenge and press FIRE. Each player has an independent six-chamber
revolver with one bullet; blanks never reshuffle it. Last survivor wins.
Use the gear for volume/reduced effects and Manage players for names/resets.
Progress saves automatically in this browser for this file location.
A refresh during a shot recovers its committed result.
Phones: transfer the HTML to a browser that supports local HTML with JavaScript.
Some phone file-viewer apps only show a preview; use a full browser or a local server.

Made with original SVG art and synthesized audio; GSAP bundled locally.

LANDSCAPE UI
Rotate phones to landscape. Portrait shows a rotate-device prompt.
All game screens fit in one landscape viewport. No page scrolling required.
Use the square-corners button for optional fullscreen. Browser support varies.
Back and settings are unavailable during a shot. FIRE unlocks after entry.
